description: Bare structure: folders, settings.do, and settings.yml only, no do-files, .env, or AI files.

git.gitignore_content:
# Framework Stata project
# As in R and Python projects, git ignores data by folder, not by file type:
# everything under a private/ folder stays out of git, and so do logs, cache,
# scratch, and tmp folders. Data in other folders, such as a public .dta,
# can be committed. Put data that must stay on this machine under private/.
#
# In this project, data in inputs/ and outputs/ is committable, as in R and
# Python projects. To keep it out of git, add its folder below (for example
# /inputs/raw/), or add *.dta to ignore every Stata dataset.

# Stata logs and session files
*.log
*.smcl
*.stswp

# Private data, anywhere in the project
**/private/**
**/*_private/**

# Secrets and credentials
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
**/credentials/**
**/secrets/**
*.key
*.pem

# Logs, cache, and scratch work
**/logs/**
**/cache/**
**/scratch/**
**/tmp/**
slurm-*.out

# System files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
*~
*.tmp
*.bak
